title: Code Autopsy Benchmark Task
description: Single ground-truth benchmark task: a historical change prompt with blind evaluation (the analyzer never receives the expected lists). Ground truth is immutable under ordinary engine work.

repository.description: Corpus repository directory name under benchmarks/corpus.

base_ref.description: Repository ref the change applies to (informational; evaluation is single-state unless stated).

prompt.description: Change description given to the evaluated workflow.

ground_truth.description: Held-out expectations: seed_symbols (query entry points), expected_impacted_symbols (qualified names or file paths), expected_failure flag, expected_failure_classes (change vocabulary), expected_coverage, and is_held_out partitioning.
